values.en: A **homotopy of paths** in $X$ is a family $f_t\colon I\to X$ ($0\le t\le 1$) such that $f_t(0)=x_0$ and $f_t(1)=x_1$ are independent of $t$ and the associated map $F(s,t)=f_t(s)$ is continuous. Two paths connected in this way are **homotopic**, written $f_0\simeq f_1$; the relation is an equivalence relation (Hatcher Proposition 1.2, p. 26).
values.zh-CN: $X$ 中的**道路同伦**是一族映射 $f_t\colon I\to X$（$0\le t\le 1$），满足端点 $f_t(0)=x_0$、$f_t(1)=x_1$ 与 $t$ 无关，且 $F(s,t)=f_t(s)$ 连续。能以这种方式连接的两条道路称为**同伦**的，记作 $f_0\simeq f_1$；该关系是等价关系（Hatcher 命题 1.2，第 26 页）。
